context: Figure 3: A graphical representation of the construction used in the proof of approximate PTC rigidity. The coordinates along the axes represent different values of the local variables β and γ, here discretized to 15 possible values each. The color of each square gives the value of Alice’s outcome a(β, γ) = 0 (yellow) and a(β, γ) = 1 (blue). On the left, the lighter region depicts the set Υ on which the binary token functions tβ and tγ are defined (given below the axes) and satisfy a(β, γ) = tβ ⊕ tγ ⊕ 1. On the right, the token functions are extended on the whole set of local variables by setting them to 0 outside of Υ.
